notes: purchase orders: generated screen blocked insert of lines / update of the header (the .fmb blocks are opened at runtime by CHECK_CLOSE/DEF_USR_SEC); same columns as the generated screen; legacy rules in APP_RULES_PR Wave 3b: legacy LOVs (order types, suppliers, agreements of the supplier, stores, order types, payment methods / conditions, items, units, services, asset types), type fixed after insert, confirm / close / bonus-with-VAT / percent check boxes, item / service / asset names, received and outstanding quantity per line.

rules.where: NVL(ST_SRV_ASST_FLAG, 0) != 4 AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR SUPPLIER_CODE IS NULL OR (SUPPLIER_CODE >= (SELECT FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) AND SUPPLIER_CODE <= (SELECT TO_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

after_save.name: delete: refuse confirmed / closed, remove lines

PR_ORDER.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where nvl(effect, 0) = 7 and nvl(trns_type, 0) = 14 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

PR_ORDER.SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

PR_ORDER.CNTRCT_SERIAL.lov: select a.serial || ' - ' || k.name_a || ' - ' || to_char(a.end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') d, a.serial r from st_supp_agrmnt a, supplier s, st_supp_agrmnt_supp p, st_good_kind k where p.supplier_code = s.code and a.serial = p.serial and a.kind_code = k.kind_code and s.code = :PAGE_SUPPLIER_CODE and nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 order by 2

PR_ORDER.STORE_CODE.lov: select store_code || ' - ' || name_a d, store_code r from st_store where store_status = 1 and nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

PR_ORDER.REQUISITION_TYPE.lov: select serial || ' - ' || nvl(name_a, name_e) d, serial r from st_pr_order_types order by 2

PR_ORDER.PAYMENT_METHOD.lov: select pay_cond_code || ' - ' || pay_cond_desc d, pay_cond_code r from lc_pay_cond order by 2

PR_ORDER.PAYMENT_CONDITION_CODE.lov: select cond_no || ' - ' || cond_desca d, cond_no r from lc_pay_credit_cond order by 2

PR_ORDER_DET.ITEM_CODE.lov: select m.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(m.name_a, m.name_e) d, m.item_code r from st_item m, st_item_group g, st_item_unit u where m.item_group_code = g.item_group_code and u.group_code = m.item_group_code and u.item_code = m.item_code and nvl(m.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and nvl(g.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and nvl(u.basic_unit, 0) = 1 order by 2

PR_ORDER_DET.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

PR_ORDER_SRVC.SERVICE_CODE.lov: select service_code || ' - ' || name_a d, service_code r from st_pu_services where leaf = 1 order by 1

PR_ORDER_ASST.CTGRY_CD_ASST.lov: select ctgry_cd_asct || ' - ' || desc_a_asct d, ctgry_cd_asct r from as_ctgry where leaf = 1 order by 1

PR_ORDER_DET.ITEM_NAME_A.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.group_code)

PR_ORDER_DET.RECEIVED_QTY.sql: (select nvl(sum(nvl(ld.income_quantity, 0)), 0) from pr_income_lot_det ld, pr_income_lot lm where ld.trns_type_code = lm.trns_type_code and ld.trns_serial = lm.trns_serial and lm.order_trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and lm.order_trns_serial = t.trns_serial and ld.group_code = t.group_code and ld.item_code = t.item_code and ld.unit_code = t.unit_code)

PR_ORDER_DET.OUTSTANDING_QTY.sql: greatest((select nvl(sum(nvl(d2.quantity, 0)), 0) from pr_order_det d2 where d2.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and d2.trns_serial = t.trns_serial and d2.group_code = t.group_code and d2.item_code = t.item_code and d2.unit_code = t.unit_code) - (select nvl(sum(nvl(ld.income_quantity, 0)), 0) from pr_income_lot_det ld, pr_income_lot lm where ld.trns_type_code = lm.trns_type_code and ld.trns_serial = lm.trns_serial and lm.order_trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and lm.order_trns_serial = t.trns_serial and ld.group_code = t.group_code and ld.item_code = t.item_code and ld.unit_code = t.unit_code), 0)

PR_ORDER_SRVC.SERVICE_NAME.sql: (select max(s.name_a) from st_pu_services s where s.service_code = t.service_code)

PR_ORDER_ASST.DESC_A_ASCT.sql: (select max(c.desc_a_asct) from as_ctgry c where c.ctgry_cd_asct = t.ctgry_cd_asst)
